selinsa

Store Submission

PDF imposition tool

selinsa is an app that handles PDF imposition entirely on mobile devices. It processes data securely on-device without sending anything to a server. Supports a wide range of use cases including doujinshi submission data, booklet imposition, and business card layout.

Key Features

  • PDF imposition (saddle-stitch, perfect binding)
  • Fully local processing — data never leaves the device
  • Intuitive preview UI
  • Available on iOS and Android
